title: Teague Valley Chemical, Corbin Falls Works
summary: A chlor-alkali plant under the EPA Risk Management Program (Program 3, responding facility) with chlorine storage, rail tank car loading, a DeltaV DCS and a Triconex SIS beside a fence-line neighborhood and an elementary school, and the RMP tabletop exercise (40 CFR 68.96(b)(2)) generated from its simulated plans: a chlorine release at a rail spot while the safety system shows a valve closed that is still open.
notice: EXERCISE MATERIAL — for training use. Teague Valley Chemical Company, the Corbin Falls Works, its people, neighbors, vendors and identifiers are simulated.

scenarios.title: Ghost Line
scenarios.summary: During morning loading of a chlorine rail tank car at Rail Spot 2 the loading-arm connection fails; ESD-310 shows the isolation valves closed while the loader still sees the cloud, the Triconex key switch is found in PROGRAM, and the Works must stop the leak by hand, ask the county to shelter the Riverside Addition and the elementary school, make the NRC, SERC and LEPC calls and decide whether to trip the cell room.
